tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ rgyun 'khyer rgyas pa bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ srid zhi'i dbang phyug mchog gyur pa// dpal ldan bla ma la btud nas// lam zab bla sgrub rgyun 'khyer gyi| |chag med ngag 'don khrigs chags bri// de'ang bla sgrub zab mo'i smin grol gyi gdams pa rnams slob dpon mtshan ldan gyis slob ma dad can la myong khrid du btab pas myong ba thob nas chag med kyi dam bca' bzung ba rnams kyis thun bzhir byed na/ nam langs/ nyin gung*/ srod/ nam gung rnams so// thun gnyis byed na/ srod dang tho rangs gnyis/ gcig byed na dgong ngam zhogs par bya dgos pas/ de la thog mar mi brtan pa'i gnas rta'i steng ngam/ ko gru'am/ khyogs sam/ do li sogs su rang nyid bsdad kyang ngo bo bskyod cing g.yo ba'i gnas de lta bu sogs ma yin pa/ khang pa'i gnas mal bla gab tu grub ma grub gang yin yang stan bde bar rkang pa rdor skyil lam sems skyil/ lag pa mnyam bzhag lte 'og tu bca' ba sogs bsam gtan gyi chos bdun dang ldan pas/ dal ba brgyad 'byor ba bcu dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di rnyed par dka' zhing*/ rnyed kyang snod bcud thams cad 'dus byas mi rtag pa'i chos can/ lus can rnams kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das pas nam 'chi nges pa med/ shi nas rang dbang mi 'dug cing*/ dkar nag gi las kyis 'phen pas mtho ris dang ngan song du 'gro dgos la/ de'ang sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang ngan song gsum la sogs pa gar skyes kyang sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la sogs longs spyod pa las med pas/ nyes brgya'i bdag nyid 'khor ba'i gnas las bdag gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad thar bar bya'o// de'i phyir du ngan song 'khor ba'i gnas las skyob nus pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum las gzhan su'ang ma mchis so snyam pa kha zhe med par bya ba thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi'o| |de nas/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar gyad dang seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng gi dbus su ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/

dar gyi na bza' can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol bas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ zhabs pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab dang sbyor ba/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas su sangs rgyas dkon mchog rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa longs sku'i cha lugs can/ rgyab tu dam pa'i chos kyi ngo bo yum shes rab kyi phar phyin sems ma ser mo/ phyag bzhi las/ dang po gnyis chos 'chad dang mnyam bzhag /'og ma gnyis rdo rje dang po ti bsnams pa rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yon tu byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang ma pham pa la sogs pa/ mdun du yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ khri'i thad kyi rgyab mdun g.yas g.yon rnams su dam pa ye shes chos skyong srung ma rnams dang ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs sprin gtibs pa lta bus bskor nas bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang rang nyid la dgyes pa'i nyams can zhal rang la phyogs par bsam/ de nas/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod cing/ bstod pa gang rung gis bstod nas/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam srung ma la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la sman slad sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog /ces pa nyer gcig bya/ de nas/ rang gi spyi bor zla ba'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka dkar po dar dang rus pa rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa'i pang du/ yum rdo rje sems ma dkar mo dar dang rus pa rin po ches brgyan cing skra grol ba/ g.yas gri gug phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi 'gul nas 'khyud pa/

zhabs gnyis yab kyi sked la 'khril ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar yig brgya mu tig lta bus bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas| oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la thim par bsam/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// sogs gyis bstod nas/ sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas mchod cing byin rlabs dang thugs rje ma lus pa bsdus pa rdor sems la thim/ slar 'od 'phros pas 'gro ba rigs drug gi nyes sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la bkod pa rnams kyis yi ge brgya pa bzla bzhin pa/ 'od zer tshur bsdus/ sngags phreng la thim ma thag /sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od dkar bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ yab yum gyi sku gang mkha' gsang du 'khyil ba byang chub sems kyi ngo bo chu rgyun ltar bab/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon thams cad dud khu ltar 'og sgo gnyis dang ba spu'i khung rnams nas thon/ lus dri ma med pa shel sgong phyis pa ltar gyur par bsam zhing*/ yig brgya brgya phrag gcig bzla/ mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ rdo rje sems dpas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag go// zhes dgyes bzhin du gnang ba byin nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku lus stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba sngags phreng la thim zhing*/

de'ang 'od du zhu ba rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te thim pas lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi skyabs yul tshogs zhing du bzhugs pa la/ rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad ltos med du phul bar dmigs nas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dri med gling bzhi sogs nas/ bstsal du gsol// sogs maṇ+ḍal tshar lnga dbul/ yan lag bdun pa 'don cing dngos sam yid kyis brgya phyag dang bskor ba bya/ mthar/ tshogs zhing rnams 'od du zhu ba rang la thim par bsam/ de nas/ rang gi mdun du gyad dang seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma la rnam pa rdo rje 'chang mthing nag dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol ba/ sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa/ de ltar brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas/ rang la phyogs te dgyes bzhin bzhugs par bsam/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rigs rnams kun gyi dbang phyug ye shes sku// yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang*// zla med rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// bram ze'i rigs las mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// zung 'jug bde stong ral pa'i khur gyis brjid// zab mo lta ba'i rdo rje gdong lnga par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// bcu gnyis dka' spyad mchog gi ye shes kyi// dngos grub bum pa spyi bor rab bcings pa// nā ro ta pa gnyis 'thung bde ba'i mchog /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// skad gnyis smra ba ti mi'i 'jings zab dbus/ grub pa'i dbang phyug gdengs can kun gyi gtso// chos kyi blo gros klu dbang yid bzhin mchog

/gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gangs can go 'byed grub pa'i dbang phyug tshogs| |rgyu skar dbus su mngon par rab 'phags pa'i// bzhad pa rdo rje ri bong 'dzin pa'i dpal// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sgrub brgyud rin chen sā la'i skyed tshal dbus// gnyis med ye shes bsod nams rin chen zhes// sā ha ka ra 'dab ldan dga' ba'i dpal// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'khor ba 'jig dngos bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bdag /ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam rol rdo rje rgyal// bde stong mtha' bral cho 'phrul gar gyi gtso// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// thub dbang zhal skyin klu zhabs nyid sprul pa/ /'gro blo'i mkha' la ye shes rol pa'i gar// rnam rol mi sbyin dbang po rat+na shrī// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gnas lugs 'od du 'tsher ba'i gur khang na// de nyid mngon sum gzigs pa'i rdo rje 'dzin// mi 'phrog dpa' bo rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gus pa mchog gis gsol btab tshe// dam pa'i thugs rje g.yo med ye shes kyi// gzigs pa'i char gyis bdag sogs 'gro blo'i tshal// ye shes 'dab brgya'i lang tsho brtas pa dang*| |bde drod gtum mo'i chu skyes rab bzhad cing*// dga' bzhi rgya mtsho ches cher rgyas pa dang*// zung 'jug lhan skyes ye shes bskyed du gsol// ci byas chos su 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs| |chos rnams lam du lhong bar byin gyis rlobs// lam 'khrul bag chags zad par byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul ba rang ngo shes par byin gyis rlobs// mos gus gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs// bla ma'i rnam thar 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam par byin gyis rlobs// rang don chos sku rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// gzhan don gzugs sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// 'gro don 'bad med 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs// phrin las rgyun 'chad med par byin gyis rlobs// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs dang*/

gzhan yang*/ dpal ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang phyug /sogs phyi sgrub ltar gsol ba btab/ slar/ dpal ldan bla ma'i mtshan rnams sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim/ sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ longs spyod rdzogs pa sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ rje btsun bla ma sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim/ gnyid 'thug gi gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ lte ba nas 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rang gi lte bar thim/ 'pho ba'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma dag /tshig gi dbang thob/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal pa can du byas/ kun tu bdag dang sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'od du mer gyis zhu ba gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo rang nyid la dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas 'od du ltem gyis zhu ba rang gi spyi bor thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med mnyam pa nyid rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo// de rnams thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bzhi'o// de nas dngos gzhi la gnyis/ smin byed dang grol byed/ dang po smin lam bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang gi lha'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dga' chen khyod bdag gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes sngags su sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba ni// dus 'di nas nibazung nas ni// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bdag gis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas bdag gis gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i| |pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du so sor gzung*// mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god| |ces gsum gyisarigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung*/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ gsum gyis phyag 'tshal/ rang gi snying khar laṃ las sa dkyil ser po gru bzhi pa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu dkyil dkar po zlum po/ lte bar raṃ las me dkyil dmar po gru gsum pa/ rkang zhabs gnyis su yaṃ las rlung dkyil ljang gu gzhu lta bu'i dbus su dzhaiḥdrag po me 'bar ba'i me rlung gis bus pas lte ba'i me 'bar/ snying kha'i sa bsros/ mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ sa dkyil la bdud rtsi bab/ bde drod 'bar bas yul snang thams cad bde stong du bsam zhing*/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rang gi snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya a aḥ zhes brjod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ me tog dbul/ bum dbang gi don du/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba gdab/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang rdzas so sor thogs pa'i tshe/ rang gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang bum chu mi bskyod pa yab yum/ rang gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbu rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum/ rang gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang rdo rje 'od dpag med yab yum/ rang gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dril bu don yod grub pa yab yum/ rang gi gzugs kyi phung po dang rdor dril rnam par snang mdzad yab yum du gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha la nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i tshe dbang gi lhas dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ chu rgyun gyis lus gang*/ rigs so sos rgyas gdab/ dbang rdzas kyi lha 'od du zhu ba dbang rdzas so so'i rnam par gyur/ de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/

rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ yum rnams kyis bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ badz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma las mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ dbu rgyan thogs nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis rgyas btab/ rdo rje bsnams nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis rgyas btab/ dril bu bsnams nas/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te s+t+waṃ a haṃ| zhes dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas rgyas btab/ rdo rje dang dril bu mnyam por bzung nas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka taḥ zhes dang*/ gsang mtshan brjod/ ces dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis rgyas btab/ des ma rig pa sogs nyon mongs pa lnga rig pa ye shes lngar bsgyur bas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya'o// dbang lhas rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi ched du rdo rje rtse lnga pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes rang rang gi lag g.yas su sbyin/ slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du/ dbang gi lhas hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje thogs nas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes g.yas su sbyin/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu thogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes g.yon du sbyin/ 'khyud rgya byas nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya mi/ zhes brjod/ dbang lhas brtan byed kyi bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod/ gsang dbang gi don du/ dbang lha yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems bab pa rang gi lce thog tu bzhag pa myang zhing*/

a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi don du kha ṭ+waṃ' cang te'u thod phor tshangs skud rnams rang la gtad cing dbang bskur/ slar sher dbang gi don du/ dbang lha yab yum las spros pa'i rig ma'i lag g.yon pa rang gi g.yas su gtad cing*/ bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsungs pa la snyoms 'jug gis| oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes snyoms 'jug gi dga' ba bzhi rtogs par bya/ rig ma'i brtul zhugs kyang zhar gyis dbang lhas tshig gis byin pa mnos nas/ slar tshig dbang gi don du/ dbang lhas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes tshig tsam gyis ngo sprad pas phyag rgya chen po rtogs par byas| dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ 'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster nyid du gyis// 'gro ba bde ba nyung las rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// mtshungs pa'i rtogs pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur// zhes lung bstan dbugs dbyung gzeng bstod bgyis nas dbang lha thams cad 'od kyi rnam par rang nyid la thim/ des dbang bskur ba bzhi thob/ lus ngag yid gsum der 'dzin dang bcas pa'i dri ma dag /lam bzhi bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku bzhi thob rung gi rten 'brel 'grigs par byas par bsam/ maṇ+ḍal dbul lo// gnyis pa grol lam bsgom pa la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim mo/ dang po la gsum/ lha bskyed pa/ sngags bzla ba/ bsdu ba'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ mda'i dra ba/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/

rin po che/ pad+ma/ rgya gram gyis bteg pa rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ zla ba nya gang ba/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ yig dmar po 'od 'bar ba de las/ rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bde ba'i rdo rje'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bla ma bde ba'i rdo rje sku mdog dmar po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ zhal gcig /spyan gsum mnga' ba/ zhi 'dzum khro chags kyi lang tsho dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan bcings pa'i rtse mor nor bu/ g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pas brgyan cing*/ rdo rje phreng ba'i thod skam lnga rin po che'i rtse phran can skra mtshams su bcings pa/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ rin po che dang*| rdo rje dang*/ dar dpyangs dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi phreng bas kun nas brgyan pa/ stag lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskums pas bdud bzhi brdzis pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba'i pang du/ yum stong nyid rdo rje ma dmar mo ral pa bsnyil zhing rus pa dang rin po che dang dar gyis brgyan cing thod skam gyi do shal can spyan gsum mnga' ba/ g.yas gri gug gdengs shing*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang lhan cig tu brkyang zhing g.yas yab kyi sked la 'khril ba/ yab yum bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ yab yum gyi dpral ba gnyis su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar/ sku rdo rje dang sku rdo rje ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo/ mgrin pa gnyis su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug gi lte bar/

gsung rdo rje dang gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo g.yas pad+ma/ thugs ka gnyis su rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar/ thugs rdo rje dang thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ yab rnams kyi g.yon dril bu dang*/ yum rnams g.yon thod khrag dkur brten pa/ yab yum gyi spyan drug tu gzugs rdo rje dang gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna ba bzhir sgra rdo rje dang sgra rdo rje ma mthing nag /sna bug bzhi ru dri rdo rje dang dri rdo rje ma ser mo/ ljags gnyis la ro rdo rje dang ro rdo rje ma dmar mo/ tshigs thams cad la reg bya rdo rje dang reg bya rdo rje ma ljang gu de rnams kyi yab rnams g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ yum rnams g.yas rang rtags kyi 'dod yon 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang 'dra ba/ yab kyi gnas rnams su yab rnams dang*| yum gyi gnas rnams su yum rnams 'od 'phro ba dang bcas pas mtshan pa/ brkyang bskum gyis 'gyings pa'i rdo rje gsum dang 'dod lnga yab yum rnams kyi dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ thugs kar rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing khas mtshan par gyur par bsam/ slar yang rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje'i dpral ba'i cha stod du gyad dang seṅges bteg pa'i khri'i steng du pad+ma zla nyi'i gdan la muṃ gser gyi mdog can yongs su gyur pa las/ ston pa shākya'i rgyal po gser sbyangs dbu+ur ma'i mdog lta bu/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cus legs par mdzes pa/ g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag /zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshams sprin gsar pa lta bu'i chos gos gsum mnabs pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga rnams su/

bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis snang la rang bzhin ma grub par bzhugs pa/ rang bde ba'i rdo rje'i mgrin pa'i cha stod du/ rin chen seng khri pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang sngon po dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan spyi bor bcings shing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol te 'dzin pa'i pang du/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung yab la 'khyud pa/ yab yum gnyis ka dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing yum gyi dbu skra rgyab tu grol ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral bar sku rdo rje dang sku rdo rje ma dkar mo yab kyi g.yas 'khor lo/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje dang gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo yab kyi g.yas pad+ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje dang thugs rdo rje ma mthing kha yab kyi g.yas rdo rje/ yab rnams g.yon dril bu 'dzin cing*/ yum rnams kyis g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yab rnams rdor skyil dang yum rnams pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ bde ba'i rdo rje thugs ka'i cha stod du/ seng ge/ gyad dang*/ glang po/ rta mchog /mkha' lding brgyad brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du sna tshogs chu skyes dang*/ zla ba nya gang ba/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i steng du/ dam tshig sems dpa' 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ lhun sdug 'od 'bar gzi brjid du ma'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa mtshan dpes brgyan cing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ sku la sha 'gag dang*/ mthang gos dmar po'i steng du gur gum lta bu'i bla gos dang*/ li khri'i mdangs ltar 'tsher ba'i snam sbyar gser gyi pa tras brgyan pa mnabs pa/

phyag gnyis mtheb srin so sor sbyar ba kha sprad pa chos 'khor gyi phyag rgya can/ dbu la bka' rtags kyi sgom zhwa dmar po 'chang ba/ de'i thugs pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa kha gyes pa'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ ye shes sems dpa' rtsa ba'i bla ma ngo bo nyid ji lta ba da lta'i mngon gyur lta bu rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar bzhugs pa'i thugs rin po che mchong gur smug po gur phub pa lta bu'i nang du/ 'od lnga las grub pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga nas 'bras tsam pa ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa til gyi mar me lta bur gsal bar gyur par bsam/ de thams cad kyi gnas rnams kyi yi ge las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i tshogs spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur| slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rgyal ba rigs lngas phyag na bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba cung zad yo bar bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sgrib pa sbyangs| chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las/ longs sku'i cha lugs can rnams la rgyal ba lngas rgyas btab/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam zhing*/ de'i ngang las rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje yab yum gnas kyi lha rnams dang bcas pa til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ de thams cad kyang chu zla lta bur snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa/ de'ang thabs shes bde stong*/ byang phyogs so bdun/ tshad med bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ stobs bcu/ phar phyin drug la sogs pa'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa/

so so'i rgyan chas phyag mtshan rnams ma 'dres par yongs su rdzogs pa/ de dag sngon med pa da lta byung ba ma yin pa/ gdod nas yongs su grub pa yin pa la yin par ngo shes pa'i nga rgyal brtan pa ste/ bskyed rim mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan par bya zhing gsal snang 'don pa ni lus tha mal gyi snang zhen zlog pa'o// gnyis pa ngag tha mal gyi snang zhen bzlog pa'i phyir/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje'i thugs ka'i thugs rdo rje'i thugs ka'i lte ba'i hūm̐ gi mtha' skor du/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru su kha badz+ra hūm̐ ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes pa dmar po g.yas su bskor ba/ dpral bar thub pa'i dbang po'i thugs ka'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du muṃ ser po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru shākya mu ne ye hūm̐ ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes pa gser btso ma lta bus g.yas su bskor ba/ mgrin pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi thugs ka'i thugs rdo rje'i thugs ka'i rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru badz+ra dhṛka ྄hūm̐ ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes pa mthing gas g.yas su bskor ba/ bde ba'i rdo rje'i thugs ka'i 'jig rten mgon po'i mthar/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru rat+na shrī hūm̐ ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtha' skor du/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru bid+yā dha ra dharma kīrti karma bi dza ya se na hūm̐ ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i mthar/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru dz+nyā na garbaha hūm̐ ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes pa rnams 'od lnga 'bar bas g.yas su bskor ba/ sngags bzlas pa'i tshe sngags phreng sa bon thams cad las 'od zer rnam lnga dpag tu med pa spros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa mchod/ de rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs ma lus pa 'od kyi rnam par bkug pa lha sngags rnams la thim/

slar 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bla ma'i go 'phang la bkod cing phyi snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rang gi bskyed rim ltar gsal ba rnams kyis kyang sngags 'bru+ug stong ldir ba ltar bzla bzhin par gyur par dmigs nas/ rang gi ngag tu/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gu ru su kha badz+ra shākya mu ni badz+ra dhṛka ྄rat+na shrī dharma kīrti dz+nyā na garbaha hūm̐ ma hā mu dra sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes pa mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzlas pa'i skyon drug spangs nas rab stong*/ 'bring brgya/ tha ma nyer gcig 'khyer so gsum dang ldan pas bzla bar bya'o// gsum pa lha skur zhen pa 'gog pa'i phyir bsdu rim ni/ rang gi dpral ba'i thub pa'i dbang po'i sku lus stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba 'od phung gi rnam pa mar bab pa mgrin pa'i rdo rje 'chang yab yum la thim/ rdo rje 'chang yum yab la thim/ yab thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ sa bon 'od du zhu ba snying gi 'jig rten mgon po la thim/ de dag kyang stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba rtsa ba'i bla mar thim/ de nyid 'od du zhu ba rdo rje la thim/ rdo rje 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ la thim/ de'ang zhabs kyu khog pa mgo zla tshes thig le nā da'i bar bsdus shing*/ nā da'ang mi dmigs par bsam mo// gnyis pa yid tha mal gyi snang zhen spang ba'i phyir/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni gnyis/ mtshan bcas dang mtshan med do// dang po ni/ lus gnad me thab drug bcings byas la/ rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje'i rdo rje gsum gyi lha rnams dang rdo rje lnga'i lha yab yum rnams 'od du zhu ba gnas so sor thim zhing*| rang bde ba'i rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi sku'i dbus su a wa dhū ti phyi sngo ba nang dmar ba yar sne tshangs bug mar sne gsang gnas su slebs pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo dang*/

g.yon tu rkyang ma dkar po gnyis yar sne klad rgya'i steng nas phyir gug pa sna bug gnyis su zug cing*/ mar sne gnyis dbu ma'i nang du cung zad gug pa/ de gsum ka ba lta bur gnas pa'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo dkar po rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dmar po rtsa 'dab bcu drug /snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsa 'dab brgyad/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ser po rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo ljang gu rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de ltar rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga po thams cad kyang chu shing ltar drang ba/ thams cad til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ phru ma phus btab pa ltar stong pa/ pad+ma'i snal ma ltar phra ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus su/ thabs kyi rang bzhin pha las thob pa'i byang sems dkar po haṃ yig gi rnam pa mgo thur du bstan pa'i nu ma'am zhun mar gyi zar bu lta bu/ bde skyong 'khor lo'i dbus su shes rab kyi rang bzhin ma las thob pa'i thig le dmar po a shad gyen du langs pa lta bu/ de'ang rnam pa me yi rang bzhin/ ngo bo bde ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ kha dog dmar ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi'am/ yang na gtum mo sa'i rang bzhin sra zhing brtan pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba/ chu'i rang bzhin brlan zhing gsher ba 'dzag med kyi bde ba/ me'i rang bzhin tsha zhing sreg pa 'pho med kyi bde ba/ rlung gi rang bzhin yang zhing g.yo ba lhan skyes brjod med kyi bde ba ste/ 'byung bzhi'i rang bzhin bde ba bzhi yi bdag nyid mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su buṃ dkar po/ rtsa 'dab mdun du hūm̐ sngon po/ g.yas su aṃ ser po/ rgyab tu dz+riṃ dmar po/ g.yon du khaṃ ljang gu rnams mgo phyir bstan pa/ longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab kyi mdun du māṃ sngon po/ g.yas su lāṃ ser po/

rgyab du pāṃ dmar po/ g.yon tu tāṃ ljang gu rnams mgo nang du bstan pa thams cad kyang rtsa mdud las grub par bsam/ bum can gcig bzung la/ ro rkyang gi rlung gis bus pas a shad la bsnun pas de las mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyi me 'bar ba dbu ma'i nang brgyud snying khar slebs pas yi ge lnga sreg pa'i tshe nyon mongs pa lnga der 'dzin dang bcas pa dang phung po lnga sbyangs/ mgrin par slebs nas yi ge bzhi sreg pa'i tshe gnas skabs bzhi der 'dzin dang bcas pa dang 'byung ba bzhi sbyangs/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pa'i tshe zhun mar gyi zar bu la tsha ba'i gdung bas reg pa na 'bad med du 'dzag pa ltar haṃ las dkar cha kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ rnam pa ga pur gyi chu lta bu/ ngo bo bde ba/ mtshan nyid bzhi ldan ngang nar gyis bab pa na/ me lce je thung du song nas dkar cha mgrin par sleb cing mgrin pa'i yi ge bzhi slar gsos pa'i tshe/ 'byung ba bzhi yum bzhi'i ngo bo stong pa bzhi yi rang bzhin du byas/ slar bab snying khar sleb cing yi ge lnga gsos pa na/ nyon mongs lnga phung po lnga sogs rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bo ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du byas/ dkar cha lte bar sleb cing me a shad la thim/ slar bum can gcig bzung ba'i tshe rlung gis a shad sbud pas me 'bar dbu ma'i nang brgyud haṃ la reg pas dkar cha zag pa mgrin par dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar sleb tshe me lce a shad la thim zhing*/ dkar chas a shad la reg la khad tsam lhan skyes kyi dga' ba ste lugs 'byung dang*/ slar dkar chas a shad la reg pa'i tshe me lce la zhun mar thigs pa ltar a shad las tsheg sgra dang bcas te me lce 'bar ba'i me lces dkar cha ded nas rim gyis steng du 'bar ba'i tshe/ me lce dang byang sems lte bar slebs pa dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ dkar cha haṃ la thim zhing me lce dkar cha la reg la khad tsam la/

lhan skyes kyi dga' ba ste lugs las ldog pa'o// de nas me lce rim gyis smad de a shad la thim la khad me sor bzhi tsam 'bar ba la sems gtad do// slar bum can bzung bas gtum mo'i me 'bar haṃ la reg pas/ dkar cha thig le'i tshul du bab pa haṃ las chad ma thag pa spyi bor cha bcu drug pa/ de'i phyed mgrin par bab pas cha brgyad pa/ de'i phyed snying khar bab pas cha bzhi pa/ de'i phyed lte bar bab pas cha gnyis pa/ de'i phyed gsang bar bab pas cha gcig pa/ de'i phyed dngul chu'i rdog po ltar rdo rje'i sbug nas rtse mo'i bug par son pa thon la khad tsam du nye ba na 'pho med du bcings/ pho rlung dgang sgril nywa bzhi sgrim mig gyen du zlog /de'i tshe thig le phyed phyed bab cing phyed phyed 'khor lo so sor gnas pas bde ba g.yo zhing 'bar/ slar gtum mo'i me lces thig le gyen du ded pa gcig gi cha lte ba'i gcig po la thim/ de bzhin snying kha/ mgrin pa/ spyi bor rim bzhin thig le phyed po phyed po la thim pas spyi bor 'pho med du brtan pa bcu drug cha rgyas pa de nyid haṃ la thim par sems gtad/ slar me lce haṃ la reg pa'i dkar cha 'o ma'i rgyun ltar bab pa me lce dang 'dres pas/ dkar dmar ro gcig tu bab pa spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab thams cad gang zhing mgo bo'i nang thams cad dkar dmar 'dres pas gang*/ slar ma shong bar bab pas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab gang*/ de nas bab pas snying kha/ de nas lte ba/ de nas gsang gnas yan chad gang*/ slar ma shong bas yan lag dang*/ nying lag /ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad dkar dmar 'dres pas khrigs mer gyis gang*/ zag pa med pa'i bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes kyis rgyud yongs su brlan par byas/ lus snang stong*/ ngag grag stong*/ sems gsal stong gi ngang du cham cham song zhing lus phyi nang thams cad lha sku 'dzin med chu zla lta bur dkar dmar 'dres pa 'od lnga'i rang bzhin lha sku sgyu ma lta bu 'ja' lus 'od phung du 'bar bar bsams pa la sems 'dzin pa ni mtshan ma dang bcas pa'i rdzogs rim mo// 'og sgo la rgyun 'khyer byed na/

skabs 'dir thabs ldan gnyis po gang rung la sems sbyang ba gzhung ltar bya ba gces so// gnyis pa mtshan med kyi rdzogs rim ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos bdun bcas la/ rang nyid bde ba'i rdo rje yab yum rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa'i stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba thugs ka'i rtsa 'khor yi ge dang bcas par thim/ de'ang mtha' nas rim gyis bsdus pa sogs kyis yi ge bzhi la thim/ yi ge bzhi po dbus kyi buṃ la thim/ buṃ yig zhabs kyu khog pa nga ro la rim gyis thim zhing*/ de'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas gnas lugs rang gshis ye khyab gsal stong zung 'jug du ma ro gcig rjen gsal 'dzin med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag /'pho ba sogs rgyun 'khyer du sbyang ba'i las phran yod na skabs 'dir sbyang*/ rjes su rang gi dge rtsa bde skyid thams cad sems can gyi ched du gtong zhing*/ de rnams kyi las 'bras sdug bsngal thams cad rang gis len 'dod kyi bsam pa zhe thag pa nas bdag gzhan brje ba theg chen sems bskyed 'khor gsum yongs dag gi ngang nas/ bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po 'di la brten nas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sogs dang*/ bdag nam 'chi ba'i tshe sogs gtor gsol 'debs ltar dang*/ bdag 'khor ma tshar gsum gyi rjes su/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i sogs sho lo ka dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sogs brjod la/ lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol ba'i bya ba gzhan la 'jug par bya'o// de ltar lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i nyams len chag med rgyun 'khyer 'di'ang bla sgrub bzhi dang*/ rtsa rlung rdzogs rim rnams nas snying po rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus shing 'khyer bde bar bkod pa 'di'ang*/ mgon po 'bri gung pa'i rigs dang chos kyi rgyal tshab rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ rang lo so bdun pa lcags khams lug gi lo zla ba drug pa'i gral tshes dge bar/
